subject.title: Feature: Inject context window % into system prompt runtime section

question: Should OpenClaw expose live context usage in every turn's system-prompt Runtime line, and if yes what freshness and format contract should it use?
rationale: The data exists in status/session tooling, but making it passive prompt metadata changes the model-facing runtime contract and may create prompt-cache churn or overlap with runtime self-context work.

options.title: Approve a narrow fresh-only Runtime field
options.body: Render a compact percentage only when the session has a fresh `totalTokens/contextTokens` snapshot, with focused tests for stale and unavailable counters.

options.title: Fold into runtime self-context
options.body: Keep this issue open under the broader runtime self-context contract and avoid adding a standalone Runtime field until that design lands.

options.title: Reject passive prompt exposure
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, and `session_status` as the only supported context-usage surfaces to avoid per-turn prompt churn.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow fresh-only Runtime field
recommendation.body: Render a compact percentage only when the session has a fresh `totalTokens/contextTokens` snapshot, with focused tests for stale and unavailable counters.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the most recent current-main refactor around the Runtime prompt and status formatting surfaces touched by either implementation path.
